io.name: clk
io.description: Clock input; circuit samples on the posedge.

io.name: a
io.description: Single-bit control input sampled at each posedge.

io.name: q
io.description: 3-bit state output, updated at each posedge.

functional_summary.overview: 3-bit up/down counter with saturating behavior. When a=1, q holds its value. When a=0, q increments by 1 each clock, wrapping from 7 to 0 (observed wrap 6->0 in trace, consistent with mod-8 increment).
rules: On each posedge of clk: if a == 1, q retains its previous value.
On each posedge of clk: if a == 0, q increments by 1 modulo 8 (i.e., q_next = (q + 1) mod 8).
q is a 3-bit register initialized to an unknown value at time 0 and updated only on posedge clk.
